correctness.rationale: Use the prior compact invariant graph Γ and graph-relative dense plateau preimages as explicit hypotheses proved in the cited primary theorem. The countable closed cover of every disk by inverse images F^{-n}(Γ) admits a nonempty interior via Baire; an affine itinerary cell has rank0 or rank1 image. Rank1 image intersects a relatively open dense plateau basin. For early rank0 branches independent exact rational interval splitting of both first-image rays produced all 10-step cell counts and only three constant points, each eventually captured by the displayed four-cycle. Later rank losses after finite graph entrance can only collapse a Γ plateau edge. Thus every plane disk contains open periodic-capture subset. No conclusion for boundary itineraries or planar full measure.
residual_risks: All-plane result is open-dense and eventual periodicity, not full Lebesgue measure or all-orbit classification.
Only the exact parameter b=3/2 with a=-1 is proved, conditional on cited published Γ properties.
